```{r}
#| output: asis
#| label: tbl-validation-summary
#| tbl-cap: !expr 'sR$`tbl-validation-summary`$`tbl-cap`'
#| tbl-cap-location: top

# NEOIPC-PERMANENT(dataset-format): see rename_legacy_antibiotic_table() in
# this report's _setup.qmd. A dataset serialized before neoipcr 0.0.0.9002
# carries no validation summary at all, and one built with the validation
# pass switched off carries an empty one; the section says which instead of
# failing the render.
validation_strings <- sR$`tbl-validation-summary`
own_summary <- benchmark_data$validationSummary$own
ref_summary <- benchmark_data$validationSummary$ref
if (is.null(own_summary)) {
  no_data_table(validation_strings$not_available)
} else if (!has_validation_summary(own_summary)) {
  no_data_table(validation_strings$pass_not_run)
} else {
  # The column groups carry the labels the report's other tables give the
  # two datasets.
  summaries <- list(own_summary)
  names(summaries) <- sR$own_data_label
  if (has_validation_summary(ref_summary))
    summaries[[sR$reference_data]] <- ref_summary
  tbl <- format_validation_summary_table(summaries, sR)
  if (is.null(tbl)) no_data_table(validation_strings$no_removals) else tbl
}
```

```{r}
#| output: asis
# A reference dataset without a summary of its own contributes no column
# group; the reader is told rather than left to wonder.
if ("ref" %in% benchmark_data$dataset_names &&
    has_validation_summary(own_summary) &&
    !has_validation_summary(ref_summary))
  cat("\n", validation_strings$reference_not_available, "\n", sep = "")
```
